about: The wiki monster pages of every dossier entry. build_fight_fields.py reads their infoboxes to write the entry's elementalWeakness, and fetch_pages.py fetches them.

monsters maps each kind of monster to its pages. The field names the kinds only when their weakness differs. Page#Name takes the versions of the page whose infobox tab or version name is Name, such as Zaros or Lvl 29, and the plain page takes its other versions.
source says where the list of pages came from.
